mentions.note: died aged under 21; walker known as "Jim"; won Belgrave Open Seven Miles handicap and London Fire Brigade S.C. 2 miles; 5th in Polytechnic H. Invitation Team Walk, White City

share.d: H. S. Latter in The Belgravian, the Belgrave Harriers club gazette, 1934: 1 mention in 1 issue and 1 race result.
